license_required.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to profess to be a podiatrist or to practice or assume the duties incident to podiatric medicine unless licensed to do so by the Arkansas Board of Podiatric Medicine.

issuing_authority.quote: licensed to do so by the Arkansas Board of Podiatric Medicine

age_minimum.quote: Is twenty-one (21) years of age or over

degree_required.quote: A diploma issued by an accredited school of podiatric medicine, approved by the American Podiatric Medical Association, Inc., bestowing the degree "Doctor of Podiatric Medicine"

accrediting_body.value: Council on Podiatric Medical Education of the American Podiatric Medical Association, Inc.
accrediting_body.quote: school of podiatric medicine recognized by the Council on Podiatric Medical Education of the American Podiatric Medical Association, Inc.

required.quote: A certificate issued by an accredited podiatric residency program approved by the Council on Podiatric Medical Education of the American Podiatric Medical Association, Inc., as proof of the satisfactory completion of a minimum of a one-year postgraduate residency program.

duration.quote: satisfactory completion of a minimum of a one-year postgraduate residency program

kind.quote: accredited podiatric residency program approved by the Council on Podiatric Medical Education of the American Podiatric Medical Association, Inc.

exams.name: Board-designated examination (written and clinical)
exams.notes: Board approves and designates the examinations; sets standards for successful completion.
exams.quote: Examinations shall be in the English language and shall be written and clinical.

interval_years.quote: A renewal fee to be established by the Arkansas Board of Podiatric Medicine in an amount not to exceed one hundred dollars ($100) shall be paid on July 1 each year.

required.quote: For renewal of a license, each licensee must present to the board a certificate of attendance at seminars or other continuing professional education courses in the health sciences as approved by the board.

period_years.quote: The number of hours of continuing education to be earned annually shall be set by the board.

regulatory_model.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to profess to be a podiatrist or to practice or assume the duties incident to podiatric medicine unless licensed to do so by the Arkansas Board of Podiatric Medicine.

title_protection.quote: If any person shall use the name or title "podiatrist", "chiropodist", "D.S.C.", "D.P.M.", "foot specialist", or any other word, abbreviation, or title to that person's name indicating or designed to indicate the qualifications to practice podiatric medicine without first obtaining from the board a license

scope_protection.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to profess to be a podiatrist or to practice or assume the duties incident to podiatric medicine unless licensed to do so by the Arkansas Board of Podiatric Medicine.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a violation of the unlawful acts statute (§ 17-96-103).
disciplinary_grounds.quote: may revoke by majority vote any certificate issued by it and cancel or suspend the registration of any podiatrist who has been convicted of violation of § 17-96-103

disciplinary_grounds.description: Found guilty of a criminal offense in any state, federal, or foreign court.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: revoke the certificate and cancel or suspend the registration of any person of whom the court records of a court of any state or territory within the United States or of the federal courts or the records of any court of jurisdiction in any foreign country show that the person has been found guilty of a criminal offense

disciplinary_grounds.description: Registration was granted upon a mistake of material fact.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: revoke the certificate and cancel or suspend the registration of any person whose registration was granted upon mistake of material fact

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful betrayal of a professional secret.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The willful betrayal of a professional secret

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having professional connections with an unregistered podiatrist or with anyone convicted of a criminal offense.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having professional connections with, or lending the use of one's name to, an unregistered podiatrist or having professional connection with anyone who has been convicted in any court of any criminal offense whatsoever

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being habitually addicted to the use of morphine, opium, cocaine, or other drugs for other than legal and legitimate purposes.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being habitually addicted to the use of morphine, opium, cocaine, or other drugs for other use than legal and legitimate purposes

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising in a false, fraudulent, deceptive, or misleading manner.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising in a false, fraudulent, deceptive, or misleading manner

disciplinary_grounds.description: Becoming physically or mentally incompetent to practice podiatric medicine so as to endanger the public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Becoming physically or mentally incompetent to practice podiatric medicine as to endanger the public

definition_quote.value: the diagnosis and medical, mechanical, and surgical treatment of ailments of the human foot and ankle
definition_quote.quote: "Podiatric medicine" means the diagnosis and medical, mechanical, and surgical treatment of ailments of the human foot and ankle

methods_authorized.quote: the diagnosis and medical, mechanical, and surgical treatment of ailments of the human foot and ankle

drug_authority.value: Podiatrists may prescribe and dispense drugs including Schedule II narcotics subject to board rules limiting amounts and requiring PDMP checks; delegation of drug administration to employees is permitted for drugs not requiring substantial specialized judgment.
drug_authority.quote: Limiting the amount of Schedule II narcotics that may be prescribed and dispensed by licensees of the board

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: "Podiatric medicine" means the diagnosis and medical, mechanical, and surgical treatment of ailments of the human foot and ankle

amputation_authorized.quote: no podiatrist shall amputate the human foot

anesthesia_authority.quote: no podiatrist shall … administer any anesthetic other than a local anesthetic

ankle_surgery_authorized.quote: All ankle surgery performed above the level of the foot other than skin and skin structures shall be performed in a facility accredited by either Medicare or by The Joint Commission.

ankle_surgery_facility_requirement.quote: All ankle surgery performed above the level of the foot other than skin and skin structures shall be performed in a facility accredited by either Medicare or by The Joint Commission.

podiatric_assistant_authorized.quote: The rules adopted under subdivision (a)(3)(A) of this section shall authorize the delegation of certain medical practices to persons other than podiatrists.

podiatric_assistant_supervision_level.quote: Medical practices delegated under this section shall be performed under the podiatrist's supervision.

opioid_prescribing_rules_required.quote: The Arkansas Board of Podiatric Medicine shall adopt rules: (1) Limiting the amount of Schedule II narcotics that may be prescribed and dispensed by licensees of the board
